answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 93 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in terrace, queued in knoll, and echo publishes the wait time. A farm of 94 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1516 identities would post 2922 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
